page: Microsoft Azure NV4ads_V710_v5 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the NVadsV710v5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance is equipped with 275 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage configurations.

This instance utilizes a fractional GPU architecture, allocating 0.1667 of an AMD V710 GPU with 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. This fractional GPU design allows for cost-efficient access to hardware acceleration without the expense of a full dedicated GPU. It is designed for workloads requiring moderate graphical or parallel processing capabilities.

Given the 4 vCPUs, 16.0 GB of RAM, and fractional V710 GPU, the NV4ads_V710_v5 is suited for entry-level virtual desktops, light 3D visualization, CAD applications, and basic GPU-accelerated development tasks. The inclusion of 275 GB of local storage and Premium Storage capability supports workloads requiring fast local read/write access.
